local_execution_driver.why: vendored timeout wraps a blocking cursor.execute in asyncio.wait_for and cannot cancel it
local_execution_driver.comparison_semantics: unchanged - result_eq, remove_distinct, postprocess imported from vendored source
local_execution_driver.verdict_parity: 120/120 identical to the vendored driver (60 tasks x {gold, wrong}, single-DB substrate)
local_execution_driver.applies_to: test_suite substrate only; single_db still uses the vendored driver verbatim

timeout_rule.gold_timeout: substrate exclusion (GOLD_ERROR) - a task whose gold cannot run is a benchmark defect, not an agent failure

metric_separation: single_database_execution_accuracy and test_suite_execution_accuracy are permanently separate metric ids; neither is ever renamed to the other
